mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library under a waxing crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will settle at an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Plan Commission is set to discuss site plans for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park on December 7th, and voters should note that general election notices are now available on the city website.
There is plenty to do in Verona with Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today, plus Art House 360 is hosting Thursday night events today, followed by Hop Haus Trivia happening this Thursday.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 19th officers conducted a traffic stop where a 49-year-old man was taken into custody on an active arrest warrant and cited for operating while suspended.
Stop by for today's flavor of the day, which is Devil's Food Cake, and remember that the restaurant is currently open until 10 PM tonight.
